nodes.label: CI skips DB migrate/seed/test without Supabase test secret
nodes.rationale: Postgres is no longer spun up in CI as a container; DATABASE_URL/SUPABASE_* point at a Supabase test project (Phase B of the Supabase migration per docs/ROADMAP.md). Without SUPABASE_TEST_DATABASE_URL configured as a repo secret, migrate/seed/test steps are explicitly skipped rather than failing the pipeline, while lint/typecheck/build always run since they don't depend on the DB.
